entries.name: Halfgreen
entries.notes: All 4 roles are in the hybrid role core. Capability atom.gardener (spawn.entity, on-death spawn a plant) sits alone at the 2-piece threshold, not stat.*. The 4-piece core is vitality (maxHp Flat) + might (atk Flat) — no More-op family, no defense channel. Name is the bare atomic seed 'halfgreen' from uniqueSetSeedPools['verdant-graft'], unused by either verdant-graft unique file (verdant-graft-50/-90).

entries.name: Sapvein
entries.notes: All 4 roles are in the hybrid role core; no weapon role claimed. Capability atom.lifesteal (resource.delta, OnDamageDealt) is the lone non-stat atom, at the lowest threshold. Tiers 3/4 are fortitude (maxHp Increased) and ferocity (atk Increased) only — both self-diminishing Increased, no More, no defense. Name is the bare atomic seed 'sapvein' from uniqueSetSeedPools['verdant-graft'], unused elsewhere.

entries.name: Surgical Cutting
entries.notes: All 4 roles are in the hybrid role core; no weapon role claimed. Capability atom.bonding (status.apply, the literal graft-take) sits alone at 2 pieces. 4-piece core is vitality (Flat) + fortitude (Increased), no More, no defense. Name: adjective 'Surgical' (themeAdjectivePools['verdant-graft'], already paired with 'Locket' in verdant-graft-50) here paired with the invented, unregistered noun 'Cutting' (a propagation clipping — growth-stage flavor, distinct token set from any existing name).

entries.name: Unresolved Ligature
entries.notes: All 4 roles are in the hybrid role core; only one weapon role (armament-secondary) claimed, never both. Capability atom.martyrdom (resource.delta, OnDeath, heals allies) alone at 2 pieces. Tiers 3/4 are might (atk Flat) and ferocity (atk Increased), no More, no defense. Name: adjective 'Unresolved' (already paired with 'Cylinder' in verdant-graft-50) here paired with invented noun 'Ligature' — a surgical binding left open, echoing the theme's own instruction never to resolve which body is in control.

entries.name: Rootstock of the Conjunction
entries.notes: All 4 roles are in the hybrid role core; no weapon role claimed. Capability atom.deathblast (resource.delta, OnDeath, burst on the corpse's cell) alone at 2 pieces — the graft keeps producing after the body stops. 4-piece core is fortitude (Increased) + vitality (Flat), no More, no defense. Name: Base 'Rootstock' (the horticultural term for the plant a graft is joined onto — invented, unregistered, resolves to itself) + concept 'conjunction' (conceptPools['verdant-graft'], unused by either verdant-graft unique file).

entries.name: Scaffold of Engraftment
entries.notes: Grand 6-piece set (rare, per ssot-sets.md#3.4) carrying thresholds at 2, 4 AND 6 as required. All 6 roles are in the hybrid role core; only one weapon role (armament-primary) claimed. Capability atom.warded (shield.grant, on hit or spawn) sits alone at 2 pieces; element is pinned to 'omni' rather than any concrete element, honoring the theme's own avoid-list ('any single dominant element'). 4- and 6-piece cores use vitality/might (Flat) and fortitude/ferocity (Increased) only, no More, no defense. Name: Base 'Scaffold' (invented, unregistered — a graft's physical support) + concept 'engraftment' (conceptPools['verdant-graft'], unused by either verdant-graft unique file).
